name: Cardamom-Pork, Spinach, Sweet Potato & Cherry Salad with Goat Cheese

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, peel, and medium dice sweet potatoes. Place on a large baking sheet pan along with cherries, oil, and spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg sweet potato
3 cup frozen cherries
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp cardamom, ground
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until cherries are soft and sweet potatoes are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
¾ tsp cinnamon, ground
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
While the chops are cooking, peel and mince shallots. Place in a large bowl along with additional oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
3 pinch cardamom, ground

instructions.primary_message: When the sweet potatoes and cherries are done, remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
Wash and dry the spinach. (Skip this step if it came pre-washed.) Add to the bowl with the dressing along with the cooled sweet potatoes and cherries. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, then top with pork. Crumble goat cheese over top and enjoy!
